newsitem.title: ISRAEL: King Hussein to meet Netanyahu - Jordanian official.
newsitem.headline: King Hussein to meet Netanyahu - Jordanian official.

text.p: Jordan's King Hussein will fly from Gaza to Tel Aviv for a meeting with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on Sunday at the end of "very successful" talks with Palestinian President Yasser Arafat, a Jordanian official said.

The king had travelled to Gaza to try to salvage U.S.-brokered peace talks between Israel and the PLO on a deal over Israeli troop redeployment from Hebron and future Israeli withdrawals from other parts of the West Bank.
Asked about the report, Netanyahu's office said no meeting had yet been set between the prime minister and the Jordanian monarch.
"The (Arafat-King Hussein) meeting was very successful," Jordanian Information Minister Marwan Muasher said in Gaza.
"We had several contacts with Egyptian President (Hosni) Mubarak, (U.S. Secretary of State Warren) Christopher, (U.S. peace envoy Dennis) Ross and Mr Netanyahu," Muasher told reporters.

"These efforts are a continuation of the Egyptian efforts to achieve a breakthrough, and the result of all these contacts is that his majesty will pay a visit to Tel Aviv to meet Mr Netanyahu," he said before the Jordanian entourage headed towards the king's helicopter for the flight to Tel Aviv.
